extracted.name: Chicken Broccoli Salad
extracted.description: This broccoli salad is a great way to use up leftover grilled chicken. The tangy mayonnaise dressing is easy to whip up, too.
ingredient_lines: 3 cooked skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed
instruction_lines: Combine broccoli, chicken, walnuts, and green onions in a large bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, and sugar together in a bowl until well blended.
Pour mayonnaise dressing over broccoli mixture; toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate until chilled, if desired. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon to serve.
